# Load coastal shapefile and define projection

```{r, ROMS.test}

# Since the data falls within two UTM zones and there is not an ideal projection to use, apply a custom equal area Albers projection
aea_custom <- "+proj=aea +lat_1=30 +lat_2=50 +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-124.5 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

# High res coastal boundary from NOAA
land.barrier <- read_sf(here(dir, "Data", "Shapefiles", "land.barrier.shp"))

# Load YearSeason gaps to fill
load(file = here(dir, "Data", "ExampleRun",
                                    "est.missing.time2.rda"))

```

# Load YearSeason data (with MLD) and calculate density

Note you will need to redefine the transect centres to get X and Y and that you need to adjust the data depending on whether a fixed 30m or mld is used.

```{r, load.seasonal.data.mld}

# Load new sdm data
TwoSeas.dat <- fread(here(dir, "Data", 
                           "mld.final_table_allHistoric.csv"))

# Boxplot to check for "Empty" combinations and outliers
lengthBinBoxPlot <-
  ggplot(TwoSeas.dat %>%
         filter(len.bin != "" & 
                  !Year %in% c(2009:2011) &
                  Year < 2021 & 
                  Season == "Summer"), 
       aes(x = as.factor(YearSeas), y = Bin_Haul_Biomass, fill = len.bin)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() + # Weights are usually log-normal
  facet_wrap(~len.bin, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Sardine Weight Distribution",
       x = "Year/Season", 
       y = "Total Weight (Log Scale)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

ggsave2(filename = "lengthBinDataBoxPlot.jpeg",
        plot = lengthBinBoxPlot, 
        device ="jpeg",
        path = here(dir, "Final.Figures"),
        dpi = 1200, width = 29, height = 21,
        unit = "cm", limitsize = FALSE)

```


```{r, create.transect.data}

# Step 1: Aggregate your raw data per haul and per length bin
survey_aggregated <- TwoSeas.dat %>%
  mutate(len.bin = case_when(
    len.bin == "" | is.na(len.bin) ~ "EMPTY",
    len.bin == "200+"              ~ "200plus",
    TRUE                           ~ as.character(len.bin)
  )) %>%
  mutate(merged.bin = case_when(
    len.bin == "EMPTY"             ~ "EMPTY",
    len.bin == "200plus"           ~ "200plus",
    len.bin %in% c("150to200", "less150") ~ "less200",
    TRUE                           ~ as.character(len.bin)
  )) %>%
  mutate(merged.bin2 = case_when(
    len.bin == "EMPTY"             ~ "EMPTY",
    len.bin == "less150"           ~ "less150",
    len.bin %in% c("150to200", "less150") ~ "150plus",
    TRUE                           ~ as.character(len.bin)
  )) %>%
  group_by(keys, Year, Season, Fin_sweep.m3, latBin, len.bin, merged.bin, 
           merged.bin2, YearSeas, YearSeas.nm, mean_depth, start_latitude, 
           start_longitude, stop_latitude, stop_longitude, Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_W = sum(Bin_Haul_Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    Species_weight = first(Species_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Extract unique HAULS and their metadata
unique_hauls_meta <- survey_aggregated %>%
  group_by(keys, Year, Season, Country, latBin, YearSeas, YearSeas.nm) %>%
  summarise(
    Fin_sweep.m3    = first(Fin_sweep.m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_depth      = first(mean_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    start_latitude  = first(start_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    start_longitude = first(start_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    stop_latitude   = first(stop_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    stop_longitude  = first(stop_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

# Step 3: Define the valid structural pairs and cross them
# This guarantees exactly 3 structured rows per haul instead of 6 impossible ones
bin_mapping <- tibble(
  len.bin    = c("less150", "150to200", "200plus"),
  merged.bin = c("less200", "less200",  "200plus"),
  merged.bin2 = c("less150", "150plus",  "150plus")
  
)

master_grid_with_meta <- unique_hauls_meta %>%
  crossing(bin_mapping) # Crosses the haul metadata with only the valid pairs

# Step 4: Join the true catch weights back onto your master grid
survey.transects.st.final <- master_grid_with_meta %>%
  left_join(
    survey_aggregated %>% 
      filter(len.bin != "EMPTY") %>% 
      # Isolate just the structural keys and the catch data
      select(keys, len.bin, Total_W, Species_weight), 
    by = c("keys", "len.bin")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_W        = coalesce(Total_W, 0),
    Species_weight = coalesce(Species_weight, 0),
    FID            = keys,
    len.bin        = as.factor(len.bin)
  )

# Note data will be in wgs84
survey.transects3.sf <- 
  make_transect_sf(survey.transects.st.final, crs = 4326) 

survey.transects3.sf.clip <- survey.transects3.sf %>%
  mutate(X = st_coordinates(st_centroid(.))[,1],
         Y = st_coordinates(st_centroid(.))[,2]) %>%
  filter(Y < 52)

range(survey.transects3.sf.clip$Y)
# [1] 31.3443 51.4088

## Create X Y columns and extract polygon centers
TwoSeas.dat4 <- survey.transects3.sf.clip %>%
  # Project the data to Albers Conical Equal Area
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom) %>%
  # Extract the centre of the transect (this is in km)
  mutate(X = st_coordinates(st_centroid(.))[,1]/1000,
         Y = st_coordinates(st_centroid(.))[,2]/1000) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() 

range(TwoSeas.dat4$X)
# [1] -341.9713  668.1958

range(TwoSeas.dat4$Y)
# [1] -962.797 1287.434

```

# Split data by Season

Note that there is no Canadian data for the spring.

## For Season 2 define spatial boundaries

```{r, sptl.boundaries2}

# Filter the data frame
data_for_3bin_model <- TwoSeas.dat4 %>%
  filter(Season == "Summer" & !Year %in% c(2009:2011) &
           # To be able to compare with ROMS
           Year < 2021
         ) 

# Delineate spatial domain
data_for_3bin_model <- 
  data_for_3bin_model[data_for_3bin_model$X >= min(data_for_3bin_model$X) & 
                 data_for_3bin_model$X <= max(data_for_3bin_model$X) & 
                 data_for_3bin_model$Y >= min(data_for_3bin_model$Y) & 
                 data_for_3bin_model$Y <= max(data_for_3bin_model$Y), ]

# Function to test for values ending in .1
integerFunction <- function(x) {
  abs(x %% 1 - 0.1) < 1e-8
}

vals <- integerFunction(est.missing.time2) 

# Apply the function to filter values ending in .1
est.missing.time.S2 <- est.missing.time2[vals]
est.missing.time.S2
# [1] 2009.1 2010.1 2011.1 2020.1

```

# Group like gear configurations

This is based on the literature and survey reports across the US and Canadian Survey segments. Each group used the same gear configuration and overall strategy, but may have more samples in some years than others. The general gear opening dimensions are also comparable within each group.

```{r, gear.configs}

data_for_3bin_model <- data_for_3bin_model %>%
  mutate(GearConfig = case_when(
    Country == "Canada" & Year < 2017 ~ "CADpre2017",
    Country == "Canada" & Year == 2017 ~ "CAD2017",
    Country == "Canada" & Year > 2017 ~ "CADpost2017",
    Country == "USA" & Year < 2011 ~ "USApre2011",
    Country == "USA" & Year >= 2011 & Year < 2015 ~ "USA2011-2014",
    Country == "USA" & Year >= 2015 & Year < 2020 ~ "USApost2014"
  ))

```

# Define offset

```{r, Offsets}

data_for_3bin_model <- data_for_3bin_model %>%
  mutate(LogArea = log(Fin_sweep.m3),
         LogArea30 = log(Fin_sweep.m3/30),
         LogAreaMLD = log(Fin_sweep.m3/mean_depth)
  )

fwrite(data_for_3bin_model, 
       here(dir, "Data", "data_for_3bin_model_w_zeros.csv"), 
       sep = ","
       )

```

# Define study plan

General Steps:

Step 1: The Foundation (Mesh & Barrier)

- Because the base model without regard to length bin used a barrier mesh and 37.5 km minimum distance between nodes, as long at the matérn range is appropriate we will keep these assumptions here. If your Range is significantly larger than your 37.5 km cutoff (ideally the range should be at least 2–3x the cutoff), your mesh is fine. 

Step 2: The Error Structure (Distribution)

- Goal: Find which family (Gamma, Tweedie, LogNormal, etc.) best handles the postive catch only.
- Method: Use the winner from Step 1 and the same Stratified Folds if available.
- Note: Positive catches account for only 13% of the data and it may not be possible to use cross fold validation.

Step 3: The Ecological Signal (Covariates)

- Goal: Determine which environmental variables (temp, depth, etc.) actually improve predictions.
- Method: Use the winner from Step 1 & 2 and the same Stratified Folds.
- Selection: Use ELPD to see if adding a covariate actually adds "information" or just "noise."

Step 4: The Robustness Check (Sensitivity Analysis)

- Goal: Prove your results aren't just a fluke of the fold method.
- Method: Take your Final "Best" Model and run it through Spatial Block Folds or Random Folds.
- What you are looking for: If the model performs well in Stratified but terrible in Spatial Blocks, it means your model is good at "filling in gaps" but bad at "extrapolating." If it performs well in both, you have a very powerful, generalizable model.

# Create folds (this is your most restrictive method)

For comparing cross validation, the same folds as the global model need to be used!

```{r, test.folds}

# Load your fixed global dataset
Season.2.dat.w.folds <- readRDS(here(dir, "Season.2.dat.w.folds.rds"))

# Create a clean 1:1 lookup table
master_fold_lookup <- Season.2.dat.w.folds %>%
  select(keys, fold_id = .folds) %>%
  distinct()

```

# Load Barrier Mesh with 42.5 km minimum distance

Note this is from the full data base model output!

```{r, load.barrier.mesh.mld.42.5km.dist}

# 1. Load your "Full" mesh object (the one you saved)
barrier2mld_42.5 <- readRDS(
  file = here(dir, "Final.Results",
              "barrier2mld_42.5.rds"))

## If greater than >1,000–2,000 nodes, 
## you’re likely in trouble unless you have a lot of RAM.
length(barrier2mld_42.5$mesh$loc[,1])
# [1] 176

# Example plot code from ?add_barrier_mesh
mesh_df_water_mld_42.5 <- 
  barrier2mld_42.5$mesh_sf[barrier2mld_42.5$normal_triangles, ]
mesh_df_land_mld_42.5 <- 
  barrier2mld_42.5$mesh_sf[barrier2mld_42.5$barrier_triangles, ]

Mesh.with.barrier_mld_42.5 <-
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land.barrier) +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_df_water_mld_42.5, size = 1, colour = "blue") +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_df_land_mld_42.5, size = 1, colour = "green")

Mesh.with.barrier_mld_42.5

```

# Summarise data for alternative length bin structures

Note that for each catch weight grouping (global, 3 length bin, 2 length bin, etc.) you need to have a single entry per row. Comparisons will be made later based on predicted estimates of the cross validation output from the best models.

## For three length bins

These are: "less150", "150to200", and "200plus".

```{r, ThreeLengthBinStructureSummary}

ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds <- data_for_3bin_model %>%
  select(-c(merged.bin, merged.bin2)) %>%
  left_join(master_fold_lookup, by = "keys") #%>%
  #mutate(
  #  # Micro-jitter the data so avoid instability introduced by three samples 
  #  # per geographic coordinate
  #  X_km = (X) + case_when(
  #    len.bin == "less150"  ~ 0.001,  # Shifted 1 meter
  #    len.bin == "150to200" ~ 0.002,  # Shifted 2 meters
  #    len.bin == "200plus"  ~ 0.003   # Shifted 3 meters
  #    )
  #  )

# 2. Update it for your Length Bin data (data_for_3bin_model.w.folds)
# This keeps the exact same triangles/barrier but matches the 522 rows
ThreeLenBinMesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(
  data = ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds, 
  xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), 
  mesh = barrier2mld_42.5$mesh # This "borrows" the physical structure of the old mesh
)

```

### Fit three length bin models

```{r, ThreeLengthBinModels}

#------------------------------------------------------------------
# Structure 1: Shared Spatial Field: A single spatial field 
# common to all size classes (spatial = "on", no spatial_varying).
#------------------------------------------------------------------

# Length bin as covariate only
deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB(
  Total_W ~ 0 + as.factor(Year) + len.bin,
  data = ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"),
  mesh = ThreeLenBinMesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation 
  ## is tested by default
  time = "YearSeas.nm",
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "iid",
  spatial = "on",
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  reml = FALSE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",
  #fold_ids = "fold_id",
  silent = TRUE
)

# Cross validate
set.seed(27)
## Run the parallel process
plan(multisession, workers = 5) # Keep workers low to avoid RAM crash

cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB_cv(
  Total_W ~ 0 + as.factor(Year) + len.bin,
  data = ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"),
  mesh = ThreeLenBinMesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation 
  ## is tested by default
  time = "YearSeas.nm",
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "iid",
  spatial = "on",
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  reml = FALSE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",
  fold_ids = "fold_id",
  silent = TRUE
)
```

### Create model decision table

```{r, ThreeLenBinModelDecisions, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide"}

# ====================================================================
# 1. Define Helper Function
# ====================================================================

get_metrics <- function(objs, nm) {
  suite_nm <- if(!is.null(objs$suite)) objs$suite else "Unassigned"
  
  if (is.null(objs$main) || is.null(objs$cv)) {
    return(tibble(
      Suite = suite_nm, Model = nm, `Total ELPD` = NA, 
      `Main Sanity` = "Fit Error", `CV Sanity` = "Fit Error", `Folds Passed` = "0/5"
    ))
  }
  
  res <- try({
    pointwise <- objs$cv$data$cv_loglik
    folds <- objs$cv$fold_loglik
    n_obs <- length(pointwise)
    k_folds <- length(folds)
    
    pw_sd <- sd(pointwise, na.rm = TRUE)
    pw_se <- sqrt(n_obs * var(pointwise, na.rm = TRUE))
    fw_sd <- sd(folds, na.rm = TRUE)
    fw_se <- sqrt(k_folds * var(folds, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    main_s <- all(unlist(sdmTMB::sanity(objs$main)))
    fold_checks <- map_lgl(objs$cv$models, ~ all(unlist(sdmTMB::sanity(.x))))
    
    tibble(
      Suite = suite_nm,
      Model = nm,
      `Total ELPD` = objs$cv$sum_loglik,
      `PW SD` = round(pw_sd, 3), `PW SE` = round(pw_se, 2),
      `FW SD` = round(fw_sd, 2), `FW SE` = round(fw_se, 2),
      `Main Sanity` = if(main_s) "Pass" else "Fail",
      `CV Sanity` = if(all(fold_checks)) "OK" else "! Warning",
      `Folds Passed` = paste0(sum(fold_checks), "/", k_folds)
    )
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    return(tibble(Suite = suite_nm, Model = nm, `Main Sanity` = "Extract Error"))
  }
  return(res)
}

# ====================================================================
# 2. Run the Loop to Collect Data
# ====================================================================

Initial.model.selection.is.made = T
 
if (!Initial.model.selection.is.made) {
  
  all_results <- list(
    # Structure 1: Shared spatial field
    "Structure 1: Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 1: Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on + Offset w/MLD" =
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.MLD, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.MLD,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 2: Independent fields / No shared field
    "Structure 2: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ 0 + LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 2: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ 0 + LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl off) + Offset w/MLD" =
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVaryingMLD, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVaryingMLD,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
     # Structure 3: Shared intercept + Reference baseline field (Isolated)
    "Structure 3: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 3: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off) + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.MLD, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.MLD,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 4: Shared intercept + Reference baseline field (Nested)
    "Structure 4: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl on)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 4: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl on) + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.MLD, 
           cv = NULL,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination")
    )
  
  # Step A: Combine raw metrics into one dataframe
  summary_df <- imap_dfr(all_results, ~get_metrics(.x, .y))
  
  # ====================================================================
  # 3. Post-Process: Apply Fixed Delta Logic and Hierarchical Ordering
  # ====================================================================
  
  model_decision_table <- summary_df %>%
    # Structural hierarchy layout (Suite -> Model -> Sanity Info -> Total ELPD)
    select(
      Suite, Model, 
      `Main Sanity`, `CV Sanity`, `Folds Passed`, 
      `Total ELPD`, 
      everything() 
    ) %>%
    
    # Calculate relative DELTA ELPD grouped by Suite
    group_by(Suite) %>%
    mutate(
      # Condition: Row must pass both sanity tests and have valid ELPD data
      is_valid_baseline = `Main Sanity` == "Pass" & 
                          `CV Sanity` == "OK" & 
                          !is.na(`Total ELPD`),
      
      # FIX: Target the HIGHEST (most positive/best fit) ELPD among passing models
      baseline_elpd = if(any(is_valid_baseline)) {
        max(`Total ELPD`[is_valid_baseline], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      # Compute Delta (The top model outputs 0, inferior models output negative values)
      `DELTA ELPD` = round(`Total ELPD` - baseline_elpd, 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # Drop calculation columns and position DELTA ELPD next to Total ELPD
    select(-is_valid_baseline, -baseline_elpd) %>%
    relocate(`DELTA ELPD`, .after = `Total ELPD`) %>%
    
    # Sorting: Sort by Suite, then arrange by Delta descending 
    # This places your 0-valued best model at the top of each suite.
    arrange(Suite, desc(`DELTA ELPD`))

  # Print final corrected table
  print(model_decision_table)
}

# View(model_decision_table)

```

### Use DHARMa to test goodness of fit on best model

1) Check if the spatial random field has correctly accounted for spatial correlation.
2) Check if delta/hurdle models in sdmTMB are properly handling zero-inflation.
3) Visualize if a more complex model (*e.g.*, adding AR1 spatiotemporal fields) significantly improves the residuals compared to a simpler model. 

```{r, DHARMa.check}

set.seed(27)
# 2. Generate simulation-based residuals (recommended approach)
sim <- simulate(deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.reml, nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")
r_fit <- dharma_residuals(sim, deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.reml, 
                          return_DHARMa = TRUE)

# 3. Use DHARMa functions to plot and test
plot(r_fit)

DHARMa::testResiduals(r_fit)
# $uniformity                                                 
# 
# 	Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
# 
# data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
# D = 0.0080182, p-value = 0.6432
# alternative hypothesis: two-sided
# 
# 
# $dispersion
# 
# 	DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs. simulated
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# dispersion = 0.021929, p-value = 0.208
# alternative hypothesis: two.sided
# 
# 
# $outliers
# 
# 	DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate expectations
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# outliers at both margin(s) = 31, observations = 8529, p-value = 0.6677
# alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.003992016
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.002470869 0.005155173
# sample estimates:
# frequency of outliers (expected: 0.00399201596806387 ) 
#                                            0.003634658

ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds$resids <- r_fit$scaledResiduals # from dharma_residuals
ggplot(ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds, aes(X, Y, color = resids)) + 
  geom_point() + 
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "red",
                           midpoint = 0.5)

DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_fit)
# DHARMa zero-inflation test via comparison to expected zeros with simulation
### under H0 = fitted model
##  data:  simulationOutput
##  ratioObsSim = 1.0034, p-value = 0.252
##  alternative hypothesis: two.sided

# Test spatial autocorrelation 
## 1. Recalculate to group by location
r_aggr <- DHARMa::recalculateResiduals(r_fit, 
                                       group = interaction(ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds$X,
                                                           ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds$Y))
## 2. Get the unique coordinates that match the aggregated residuals
coords_unique <- ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds %>%
  group_by(X, Y) %>%
  summarize(.groups = "drop")
## 3. Run the test
DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(r_aggr, 
                                   x = coords_unique$X, 
                                   y = coords_unique$Y)
### DHARMa Moran's I test for distance-based autocorrelation
##  data:  r_aggr
##  observed = 0.00095333, expected = -0.00066622, sd = 0.00382219, p-value = 0.6718
##  alternative hypothesis: Distance-based autocorrelation

```

### For summary check

Null Model (M0): Total_W ~ 1 (No random effects, no fixed effects).

```{r, null.deviance}

# 0. Null Model
# Absolute Null: Baseline variance of the data
m0 <- sdmTMB(
  Total_W ~ 1,
  data = ThreeLenBin.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"), 
  mesh = ThreeLenBinMesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation 
  ## is tested by default
  time = NULL,    
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "off",
  spatial = "off",
  reml = FALSE,
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",
  #fold_ids = "fold_idx",
  silent = TRUE
)

sanity(m0)
# ✔ Non-linear minimizer suggests successful convergence
# ✔ Hessian matrix is positive definite
# ✔ No extreme or very small eigenvalues detected
# ✔ No gradients with respect to fixed effects are >= 0.001
# ✔ No fixed-effect standard errors are NA
# ✔ No standard errors look unreasonably large
# ✔ No sigma parameters are < 0.01
# ✔ No sigma parameters are > 100

```

--- THE MATH ---

```{r, deviance.explained.by.component}

d0 <- deviance(m0)
d1 <- deviance(m1_fixed)
d2 <- deviance(m2_sv)
d3 <- deviance(m3_full)

# Percentages of total deviance explained by each:
pct_full_model <- 1 - d3 / d0
pct_fixed_only <- (d0 - d1) / d0
pct_sv_only    <- (d1 - d2) / d0
pct_st_only    <- (d2 - d3) / d0

pct_full_model*100
# [1] 46.16033

pct_fixed_only*100
# [1] 19.38272

pct_sv_only*100
# [1] 13.55001

pct_st_only*100
# [1] 13.2276

```

```{r, TwoLengthBin200StructureSummary}
# 2. Update it for your Length Bin data (data_for_3bin_model.w.folds)
# This keeps the exact same triangles/barrier but matches the 522 rows
TwoLenBin200Mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(
  data = TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, 
  xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), 
  mesh = barrier2mld_42.5$mesh # This "borrows" the physical structure of the old mesh
)

```

### Create model decision table for two length bin model with 200 cut off

```{r, 200LenBinModelDecisions, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide"}

# ====================================================================
# 1. Define Helper Function
# ====================================================================

get_metrics <- function(objs, nm) {
  suite_nm <- if(!is.null(objs$suite)) objs$suite else "Unassigned"
  
  if (is.null(objs$main) || is.null(objs$cv)) {
    return(tibble(
      Suite = suite_nm, Model = nm, `Total ELPD` = NA, 
      `Main Sanity` = "Fit Error", `CV Sanity` = "Fit Error", `Folds Passed` = "0/5"
    ))
  }
  
  res <- try({
    pointwise <- objs$cv$data$cv_loglik
    folds <- objs$cv$fold_loglik
    n_obs <- length(pointwise)
    k_folds <- length(folds)
    
    pw_sd <- sd(pointwise, na.rm = TRUE)
    pw_se <- sqrt(n_obs * var(pointwise, na.rm = TRUE))
    fw_sd <- sd(folds, na.rm = TRUE)
    fw_se <- sqrt(k_folds * var(folds, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    main_s <- all(unlist(sdmTMB::sanity(objs$main)))
    fold_checks <- map_lgl(objs$cv$models, ~ all(unlist(sdmTMB::sanity(.x))))
    
    tibble(
      Suite = suite_nm,
      Model = nm,
      `Total ELPD` = objs$cv$sum_loglik,
      `PW SD` = round(pw_sd, 3), `PW SE` = round(pw_se, 2),
      `FW SD` = round(fw_sd, 2), `FW SE` = round(fw_se, 2),
      `Main Sanity` = if(main_s) "Pass" else "Fail",
      `CV Sanity` = if(all(fold_checks)) "OK" else "! Warning",
      `Folds Passed` = paste0(sum(fold_checks), "/", k_folds)
    )
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    return(tibble(Suite = suite_nm, Model = nm, `Main Sanity` = "Extract Error"))
  }
  return(res)
}

# ====================================================================
# 2. Run the Loop to Collect Data
# ====================================================================

Initial.200model.selection.is.made = T
 
if (!Initial.200model.selection.is.made) {
  
  
  all_results.200Models <- list(
    # Structure 1: Shared spatial field
    "Structure 1: Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 1: Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.MLD.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.MLD.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 2: Independent fields / No shared field
    "Structure 2: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ 0 + LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 2: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ 0 + LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl off) + Offset w/MLD" =
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVaryingMLD.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVaryingMLD.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 3: Shared intercept + Reference baseline field (Isolated)
    "Structure 3: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 3: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl off) + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.MLD.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.MLD.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 4: Shared intercept + Reference baseline field (Nested)
    "Structure 4: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl on)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 4: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl on) + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.MLD.200Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.MLD.200Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination")
  )
  
  # Step A: Combine raw metrics into one dataframe
  summary_df.200Models <- imap_dfr(all_results.200Models, ~get_metrics(.x, .y))
  
  # ====================================================================
  # 3. Post-Process: Apply Fixed Delta Logic and Hierarchical Ordering
  # ====================================================================
  
  model_decision_table.200Models <- summary_df.200Models %>%
    # Structural hierarchy layout (Suite -> Model -> Sanity Info -> Total ELPD)
    select(
      Suite, Model, 
      `Main Sanity`, `CV Sanity`, `Folds Passed`, 
      `Total ELPD`, 
      everything() 
    ) %>%
    
    # Calculate relative DELTA ELPD grouped by Suite
    group_by(Suite) %>%
    mutate(
      # Condition: Row must pass both sanity tests and have valid ELPD data
      is_valid_baseline = `Main Sanity` == "Pass" & 
                          `CV Sanity` == "OK" & 
                          !is.na(`Total ELPD`),
      
      # FIX: Target the HIGHEST (most positive/best fit) ELPD among passing models
      baseline_elpd = if(any(is_valid_baseline)) {
        max(`Total ELPD`[is_valid_baseline], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      # Compute Delta (The top model outputs 0, inferior models output negative values)
      `DELTA ELPD` = round(`Total ELPD` - baseline_elpd, 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # Drop calculation columns and position DELTA ELPD next to Total ELPD
    select(-is_valid_baseline, -baseline_elpd) %>%
    relocate(`DELTA ELPD`, .after = `Total ELPD`) %>%
    
    # Sorting: Sort by Suite, then arrange by Delta descending 
    # This places your 0-valued best model at the top of each suite.
    arrange(Suite, desc(`DELTA ELPD`))

  # Print final corrected table
  print(model_decision_table.200Models)
}

```

```{r, 200LenBinModelDecisions.update, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide"}
  # Add the new model to the list
  all_results.200Models[["Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on and w/o REML (From Suite 1)"]] <- 
    list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models, 
         cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models,
         suite = "2. Restricted Maximum Likelihood (REML) Estimation")
 all_results.200Models[["Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on and w/ REML"]] <- 
    list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models.reml, 
         cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models.reml, 
         suite = "2. Restricted Maximum Likelihood (REML) Estimation")
 
  # Step A: Combine raw metrics into one dataframe
  summary_df.200Models <- imap_dfr(all_results.200Models, ~get_metrics(.x, .y))
  
  # ====================================================================
  # 3. Post-Process: Apply Fixed Delta Logic and Hierarchical Ordering
  # ====================================================================
  
  model_decision_table.200Models <- summary_df.200Models %>%
    # Structural hierarchy layout (Suite -> Model -> Sanity Info -> Total ELPD)
    select(
      Suite, Model, 
      `Main Sanity`, `CV Sanity`, `Folds Passed`, 
      `Total ELPD`, 
      everything() 
    ) %>%
    
    # Calculate relative DELTA ELPD grouped by Suite
    group_by(Suite) %>%
    mutate(
      # Condition: Row must pass both sanity tests and have valid ELPD data
      is_valid_baseline = `Main Sanity` == "Pass" & 
                          `CV Sanity` == "OK" & 
                          !is.na(`Total ELPD`),
      
      # FIX: Target the HIGHEST (most positive/best fit) ELPD among passing models
      baseline_elpd = if(any(is_valid_baseline)) {
        max(`Total ELPD`[is_valid_baseline], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      # Compute Delta (The top model outputs 0, inferior models output negative values)
      `DELTA ELPD` = round(`Total ELPD` - baseline_elpd, 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # Drop calculation columns and position DELTA ELPD next to Total ELPD
    select(-is_valid_baseline, -baseline_elpd) %>%
    relocate(`DELTA ELPD`, .after = `Total ELPD`) %>%
    
    # Sorting: Sort by Suite, then arrange by Delta descending 
    # This places your 0-valued best model at the top of each suite.
    arrange(Suite, desc(`DELTA ELPD`))

  # Print final corrected table
  print(model_decision_table.200Models)
}

```

### Use DHARMa to test goodness of fit on best two length bin model with 200 cut off without spatial varying effects

Note this is the best model overall, which had no spatial varying effects. The name is misleading.

1) Check if the spatial random field has correctly accounted for spatial correlation.
2) Check if delta/hurdle models in sdmTMB are properly handling zero-inflation.
3) Visualize if a more complex model (*e.g.*, adding AR1 spatiotemporal fields) significantly improves the residuals compared to a simpler model. 

```{r, DHARMa.check200plus}

set.seed(27)

# 2. Generate simulation-based residuals (recommended approach)
sim.200Models <- simulate(deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models.reml, nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")

r_fit.200Models <- 
  dharma_residuals(sim.200Models, deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.200Models.reml, return_DHARMa = TRUE)

# 3. Use DHARMa functions to plot and test
plot(r_fit.200Models)

DHARMa::testResiduals(r_fit.200Models)
# $uniformity                                                 
# 
# 	Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
# 
# data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
# D = 0.0070058, p-value = 0.9333
# alternative hypothesis: two-sided
# 
# 
# $dispersion
# 
# 	DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs. simulated
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# dispersion = 0.0016725, p-value = 0.048
# alternative hypothesis: two.sided
# 
# 
# $outliers
# 
# 	DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate expectations
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# outliers at both margin(s) = 14, observations = 5923, p-value = 0.04915
# alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.003992016
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.001292822 0.003962655
# sample estimates:
# frequency of outliers (expected: 0.00399201596806387 ) 
#                                            0.002363667  

TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds$resids <- r_fit.200Models$scaledResiduals # from dharma_residuals
ggplot(TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, aes(X, Y, color = resids)) + 
  geom_point() + 
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "red",
                           midpoint = 0.5)

DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_fit.200Models)
# DHARMa zero-inflation test via comparison to expected zeros with simulation
### under H0 = fitted model
##  data:  simulationOutput
##  ratioObsSim = 1.0017, p-value = 0.668
##  alternative hypothesis: two.sided

# Test spatial autocorrelation 
## 1. Recalculate to group by location
r_aggr.200Models <- DHARMa::recalculateResiduals(r_fit.200Models, 
                                                group = interaction(TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds$X,
                                                                    TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds$Y))
## 2. Get the unique coordinates that match the aggregated residuals
coords_unique.200Models <- TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds %>%
  group_by(X, Y) %>%
  summarize(.groups = "drop")

## 3. Run the test
DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(r_aggr.200Models, 
                                   x = coords_unique.200Models$X, 
                                   y = coords_unique.200Models$Y)
### DHARMa Moran's I test for distance-based autocorrelation
##  data:  r_aggr
##  observed = 0.00356321, expected = -0.00066622, sd = 0.00382220, p-value = 0.2685
##  alternative hypothesis: Distance-based autocorrelation

```

```{r, null.deviance_200plus}

# 0. Null Model

m0_200plus <- sdmTMB(
  Total_W ~ 1,
  data = TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"), 
  mesh = TwoLenBin200Mesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation

  time = NULL,    
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "off",
  spatial = "off",
  reml = FALSE,
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",

)

sanity(m0_200plus)
# ✔ Non-linear minimizer suggests successful convergence
```

--- THE MATH ---

```{r, deviance.explained.by.component_200plus}

d0_200plus <- deviance(m0_200plus)
d1_200plus <- deviance(m1_fixed_200plus)
d2_200plus <- deviance(m2_sv_200plus)
d3_200plus <- deviance(m3_full_200plus)

# Percentages of total deviance explained by each:
pct_full_model_200plus <- 1 - d3_200plus / d0_200plus
pct_fixed_only_200plus <- (d0_200plus - d1_200plus) / d0_200plus
pct_sv_only_200plus    <- (d1_200plus - d2_200plus) / d0_200plus
pct_st_only_200plus    <- (d2_200plus - d3_200plus) / d0_200plus

pct_full_model_200plus*100
# [1] 46.51859

pct_fixed_only_200plus*100
# [1] 17.71035

pct_sv_only_200plus*100
# [1] 14.31265

pct_st_only_200plus*100
# [1] 14.49558

```

### Create model decision table for best two length bin model with 150 cut off

```{r, ThreeLenBinModelDecisions, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide"}

# ====================================================================
# 1. Define Helper Function
# ====================================================================

get_metrics <- function(objs, nm) {
  suite_nm <- if(!is.null(objs$suite)) objs$suite else "Unassigned"
  
  if (is.null(objs$main) || is.null(objs$cv)) {
    return(tibble(
      Suite = suite_nm, Model = nm, `Total ELPD` = NA, 
      `Main Sanity` = "Fit Error", `CV Sanity` = "Fit Error", `Folds Passed` = "0/5"
    ))
  }
  
  res <- try({
    pointwise <- objs$cv$data$cv_loglik
    folds <- objs$cv$fold_loglik
    n_obs <- length(pointwise)
    k_folds <- length(folds)
    
    pw_sd <- sd(pointwise, na.rm = TRUE)
    pw_se <- sqrt(n_obs * var(pointwise, na.rm = TRUE))
    fw_sd <- sd(folds, na.rm = TRUE)
    fw_se <- sqrt(k_folds * var(folds, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    main_s <- all(unlist(sdmTMB::sanity(objs$main)))
    fold_checks <- map_lgl(objs$cv$models, ~ all(unlist(sdmTMB::sanity(.x))))
    
    tibble(
      Suite = suite_nm,
      Model = nm,
      `Total ELPD` = objs$cv$sum_loglik,
      `PW SD` = round(pw_sd, 3), `PW SE` = round(pw_se, 2),
      `FW SD` = round(fw_sd, 2), `FW SE` = round(fw_se, 2),
      `Main Sanity` = if(main_s) "Pass" else "Fail",
      `CV Sanity` = if(all(fold_checks)) "OK" else "! Warning",
      `Folds Passed` = paste0(sum(fold_checks), "/", k_folds)
    )
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    return(tibble(Suite = suite_nm, Model = nm, `Main Sanity` = "Extract Error"))
  }
  return(res)
}

# ====================================================================
# 2. Run the Loop to Collect Data
# ====================================================================

Initial.model.selection.is.made = T
 
if (!Initial.model.selection.is.made) {
  
  all_results.150Models <- list(
    # Structure 1: Shared spatial field
    "Structure 1: Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 1: Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link w/spl on + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.MLD.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.MLD.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 2: Independent fields / No shared field
    "Structure 2: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ 0 + LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 2: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ 0 + LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl off) + Offset w/MLD" =
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVaryingMLD.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVaryingMLD.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 3: Shared intercept + Reference baseline field (Isolated)
    "Structure 3: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/spl off)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 3: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl off) + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.MLD.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str3.MLD.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    
    # Structure 4: Shared intercept + Reference baseline field (Nested)
    "Structure 4: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl on)" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.150Models, 
           cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.150Models,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination"),
    "Structure 4: Lognormal + LengthBin (~ LengthBin spatial_varying w/sptl on) + Offset w/MLD" = 
      list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.MLD.150Models, 
           cv = NULL,
           suite = "1. LengthBin Combination")
  )
  
  # Step A: Combine raw metrics into one dataframe
  summary_df.150Models <- imap_dfr(all_results.150Models, ~get_metrics(.x, .y))
  
  # ====================================================================
  # 3. Post-Process: Apply Fixed Delta Logic and Hierarchical Ordering
  # ====================================================================
  
  model_decision_table.150Models <- summary_df.150Models %>%
    # Structural hierarchy layout (Suite -> Model -> Sanity Info -> Total ELPD)
    select(
      Suite, Model, 
      `Main Sanity`, `CV Sanity`, `Folds Passed`, 
      `Total ELPD`, 
      everything() 
    ) %>%
    
    # Calculate relative DELTA ELPD grouped by Suite
    group_by(Suite) %>%
    mutate(
      # Condition: Row must pass both sanity tests and have valid ELPD data
      is_valid_baseline = `Main Sanity` == "Pass" & 
                          `CV Sanity` == "OK" & 
                          !is.na(`Total ELPD`),
      
      # FIX: Target the HIGHEST (most positive/best fit) ELPD among passing models
      baseline_elpd = if(any(is_valid_baseline)) {
        max(`Total ELPD`[is_valid_baseline], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      # Compute Delta (The top model outputs 0, inferior models output negative values)
      `DELTA ELPD` = round(`Total ELPD` - baseline_elpd, 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # Drop calculation columns and position DELTA ELPD next to Total ELPD
    select(-is_valid_baseline, -baseline_elpd) %>%
    relocate(`DELTA ELPD`, .after = `Total ELPD`) %>%
    
    # Sorting: Sort by Suite, then arrange by Delta descending 
    # This places your 0-valued best model at the top of each suite.
    arrange(Suite, desc(`DELTA ELPD`))

  # Print final corrected table
  print(model_decision_table.150Models)
}

# View(model_decision_table.150Models)

```

### Use DHARMa to test goodness of fit on best two length bin model with 150 cut off

1) Check if the spatial random field has correctly accounted for spatial correlation.
2) Check if delta/hurdle models in sdmTMB are properly handling zero-inflation.
3) Visualize if a more complex model (*e.g.*, adding AR1 spatiotemporal fields) significantly improves the residuals compared to a simpler model. 

```{r, DHARMa.check150plus}

set.seed(27)

# 2. Generate simulation-based residuals (recommended approach)
sim.150Models <- simulate(deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.150Models.reml, 
                         nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")

r_fit.150Models <- 
  dharma_residuals(sim.150Models, deltalognormalLogArea.w.lengthBin.CoVar.150Models.reml, 
                   return_DHARMa = TRUE)

# 3. Use DHARMa functions to plot and test
plot(r_fit.150Models)

DHARMa::testResiduals(r_fit.150Models)
# $uniformity                                                 
# 
# 	Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
# 
# data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
# D = 0.010296, p-value = 0.5469
# alternative hypothesis: two-sided
# 
# 
# $dispersion
# 
# 	DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs. simulated
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# dispersion = 0.011247, p-value = 0.076
# alternative hypothesis: two.sided
# 
# 
# $outliers
# 
# 	DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate expectations
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# outliers at both margin(s) = 16, observations = 6011, p-value = 0.1233
# alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.003992016
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.001522183 0.004318985
# sample estimates:
# frequency of outliers (expected: 0.00399201596806387 ) 
#                                            0.002661787 

TwoLenBin150.dat.w.folds$resids.150Models <- r_fit.150Models$scaledResiduals # from dharma_residuals
ggplot(TwoLenBin150.dat.w.folds, aes(X, Y, color = resids.150Models)) + 
  geom_point() + 
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "red",
                           midpoint = 0.5)

DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_fit.150Models)
# DHARMa zero-inflation test via comparison to expected zeros with simulation
### under H0 = fitted model
##  data:  simulationOutput
##  ratioObsSim = 1.0017, p-value = 0.668
##  alternative hypothesis: two.sided

# Test spatial autocorrelation 
## 1. Recalculate to group by location
r_aggr.150Models <- DHARMa::recalculateResiduals(r_fit.150Models, 
                                       group = interaction(TwoLenBin150.dat.w.folds$X,
                                                           TwoLenBin150.dat.w.folds$Y))

## 2. Get the unique coordinates that match the aggregated residuals
coords_unique.150Models <- TwoLenBin150.dat.w.folds %>%
  group_by(X, Y) %>%
  summarize(.groups = "drop")

## 3. Run the test
DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(r_aggr.150Models, 
                                   x = coords_unique.150Models$X, 
                                   y = coords_unique.150Models$Y)
### DHARMa Moran's I test for distance-based autocorrelation
##  data:  r_aggr
##  observed = 0.00174157, expected = -0.00066622, sd = 0.00382219, p-value = 0.5287
##  alternative hypothesis: Distance-based autocorrelation

```

--- THE MATH ---

```{r, deviance.explained.by.component_150plus}

d0_150plus <- deviance(m0_150plus)
d1_150plus <- deviance(m1_fixed_150plus)
d2_150plus <- deviance(m2_sv_150plus)
d3_150plus <- deviance(m3_full_150plus)

# Percentages of total deviance explained by each:
pct_full_model_150plus <- 1 - d3_150plus / d0_150plus
pct_fixed_only_150plus <- (d0_150plus - d1_150plus) / d0_150plus
pct_sv_only_150plus    <- (d1_150plus - d2_150plus) / d0_150plus
pct_st_only_150plus    <- (d2_150plus - d3_150plus) / d0_150plus
```

```{r, join.save.rmse.mae}
  ) %>%
  # Calculate % difference relative to final_full_summary
  mutate(
    `% Δ RMSE` = (`Global CV RMSE` - ref_rmse) / ref_rmse * 100,
    `% Δ MAE`  = (`Global CV MAE`  - ref_mae)  / ref_mae  * 100
  ) %>%
  # Optional: sort best to worst by RMSE
  arrange(`Global CV RMSE`) %>%
  select(-c(ref_rmse, ref_mae))

View(test2)

fwrite(test2,
```

# Re run spatial varying model with REML

Because only the 200 mm length bin group had spatial varying processes, re-run the best
spatial varying process scenario for this model group and save.

```{r, 200LenBinModelSptlVarying.w.reml}

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Length bin as covariate with spatial varying process
# with shared intercept (sptl. on)
#----------------------------------------------------------

deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB(
  Total_W ~ 0 + as.factor(Year) + merged.bin,
  data = TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"),
  mesh = TwoLenBin200Mesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation 
  ## is tested by default
  time = "YearSeas.nm",
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "iid",
  spatial = "on",
  spatial_varying = ~ merged.bin,
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  reml = TRUE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",
  #fold_ids = "fold_id",
  silent = TRUE
)

# Cross validate
set.seed(27)
# Run the parallel process
plan(multisession, workers = 5) # Keep workers low to avoid RAM crash

cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB_cv(
  Total_W ~ 0 + as.factor(Year) + merged.bin,
  data = TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"),
  mesh = TwoLenBin200Mesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation 
  ## is tested by default
  time = "YearSeas.nm",
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "iid",
  spatial = "on",
  spatial_varying = ~ merged.bin,
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  reml = TRUE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",
  fold_ids = "fold_id",
  silent = TRUE
)
```

### Update model selection table

```{r, 200LenBinModelDecisions.update2, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide"}

Initial.200model.selection.reml2.is.made = T

if (Initial.200model.selection.reml2.is.made == F){
  # Add the new model to the list
  all_results.200Models[["Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link, Sptl Varying w/spl on and w/o REML (From Suite 1)"]] <- 
    list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models, 
         cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models,
         suite = "2. Restricted Maximum Likelihood (REML) Estimation")
 all_results.200Models[["Lognormal + LengthBin: Log-link, Sptl Varying w/spl on and w REML"]] <- 
    list(main = deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml, 
         cv = cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml, 
         suite = "2. Restricted Maximum Likelihood (REML) Estimation")
 
  # Step A: Combine raw metrics into one dataframe
  summary_df.200Models <- imap_dfr(all_results.200Models, ~get_metrics(.x, .y))
  
  # ====================================================================
  # 3. Post-Process: Apply Fixed Delta Logic and Hierarchical Ordering
  # ====================================================================
  
  model_decision_table.200Models <- summary_df.200Models %>%
    # Structural hierarchy layout (Suite -> Model -> Sanity Info -> Total ELPD)
    select(
      Suite, Model, 
      `Main Sanity`, `CV Sanity`, `Folds Passed`, 
      `Total ELPD`, 
      everything() 
    ) %>%
    
    # Calculate relative DELTA ELPD grouped by Suite
    group_by(Suite) %>%
    mutate(
      # Condition: Row must pass both sanity tests and have valid ELPD data
      is_valid_baseline = `Main Sanity` == "Pass" & 
                          `CV Sanity` == "OK" & 
                          !is.na(`Total ELPD`),
      
      # FIX: Target the HIGHEST (most positive/best fit) ELPD among passing models
      baseline_elpd = if(any(is_valid_baseline)) {
        max(`Total ELPD`[is_valid_baseline], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      # Compute Delta (The top model outputs 0, inferior models output negative values)
      `DELTA ELPD` = round(`Total ELPD` - baseline_elpd, 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # Drop calculation columns and position DELTA ELPD next to Total ELPD
    select(-is_valid_baseline, -baseline_elpd) %>%
    relocate(`DELTA ELPD`, .after = `Total ELPD`) %>%
    
    # Sorting: Sort by Suite, then arrange by Delta descending 
    # This places your 0-valued best model at the top of each suite.
    arrange(Suite, desc(`DELTA ELPD`))

  # Print final corrected table
  print(model_decision_table.200Models)
}

```

### Use DHARMa to test goodness of fit on best two length bin model with 200 cut off without spatial varying effects

Note this is the best model overall, which had no spatial varying effects. The name is misleading.

1) Check if the spatial random field has correctly accounted for spatial correlation.
2) Check if delta/hurdle models in sdmTMB are properly handling zero-inflation.
3) Visualize if a more complex model (*e.g.*, adding AR1 spatiotemporal fields) significantly improves the residuals compared to a simpler model. 

```{r, DHARMa.check200plus.sptlvarying}

set.seed(27)

# 2. Generate simulation-based residuals (recommended approach)
sim.200Models.sptlVarying <- simulate(deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml, nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")

r_fit.200Models.sptlVarying <- 
  dharma_residuals(sim.200Models.sptlVarying, deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml, return_DHARMa = TRUE)

# 3. Use DHARMa functions to plot and test
plot(r_fit.200Models.sptlVarying)

DHARMa::testResiduals(r_fit.200Models.sptlVarying)
# $uniformity                                                 
# 
# 	Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
# 
# data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
# D = 0.012964, p-value = 0.2725
# alternative hypothesis: two-sided
# 
# 
# $dispersion
# 
# 	DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs. simulated
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# dispersion = 0.0096556, p-value = 0.008
# alternative hypothesis: two.sided
# 
# 
# $outliers
# 
# 	DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate expectations
# 
# data:  simulationOutput
# outliers at both margin(s) = 14, observations = 5923, p-value = 0.04915
# alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.003992016
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.001292822 0.003962655
# sample estimates:
# frequency of outliers (expected: 0.00399201596806387 ) 
#                                            0.002363667 

TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds$resids.sptlVarying <- r_fit.200Models.sptlVarying$scaledResiduals # from dharma_residuals
ggplot(TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, aes(X, Y, color = resids.sptlVarying)) + 
  geom_point() + 
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "red",
                           midpoint = 0.5)

DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_fit.200Models.sptlVarying)
# DHARMa zero-inflation test via comparison to expected zeros with simulation
### under H0 = fitted model
##  data:  simulationOutput
##  ratioObsSim = 1.0094, p-value = 0.008
##  alternative hypothesis: two.sided

# Test spatial autocorrelation 
## 1. Recalculate to group by location
r_aggr.200Models.sptlVarying <- DHARMa::recalculateResiduals(r_fit.200Models.sptlVarying, 
                                                            group = interaction(TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds$X,
                                                                                TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds$Y))
## 2. Get the unique coordinates that match the aggregated residuals
coords_unique.200Models.sptlVarying <- TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds %>%
  group_by(X, Y) %>%
  summarize(.groups = "drop")

## 3. Run the test
DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(r_aggr.200Models.sptlVarying, 
                                   x = coords_unique.200Models.sptlVarying$X, 
                                   y = coords_unique.200Models.sptlVarying$Y)
### DHARMa Moran's I test for distance-based autocorrelation
##  data:  r_aggr
##  observed = 0.00356321, expected = -0.00066622, sd = 0.00382215, p-value = 0.9755
##  alternative hypothesis: Distance-based autocorrelation

```

### For summary check of best fit 2 length bin model with 200 cut off and spatial varying effects with sptl

Null Model (M0): Total_W ~ 1 (No random effects, no fixed effects).

```{r, null.deviance_200plusSptlVarying.w.sptl}

# 0. Null Model
# Absolute Null: Baseline variance of the data
m0_200plusSptlVarying <- sdmTMB(
  Total_W ~ 1,
  data = TwoLenBin200.dat.w.folds, 
  family = delta_lognormal(type = "standard"), 
  mesh = TwoLenBin200Mesh,
  # Fit model by year and month
  ## Note if time is specified, spatiotemporal correlation 
  ## is tested by default
  time = NULL,    
  # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
  # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)
  spatiotemporal = "off",
  spatial = "off",
  reml = FALSE,
  anisotropy = FALSE,
  # Note to keep units the same a grid cell use
  offset = "LogArea",
  #fold_ids = "fold_idx",
  silent = TRUE
)

sanity(m0_200plusSptlVarying)
# ✔ Non-linear minimizer suggests successful convergence
# ✔ Hessian matrix is positive definite
# ✔ No extreme or very small eigenvalues detected
# ✔ No gradients with respect to fixed effects are >= 0.001
# ✔ No fixed-effect standard errors are NA
# ✔ No standard errors look unreasonably large
# ✔ No sigma parameters are < 0.01
# ✔ No sigma parameters are > 100

```

Fixed Effects Only (M1_200plus): Total_W ~ YearSeas.nm (No spatial/spatiotemporal engines).

```{r, deviance.explained.by.fixed.effects_200plusSptlVarying.w.sptl}

# 1. FIXED EFFECTS ALONE

m1_fixed_200plusSptlVarying <- update(m0_200plusSptlVarying, 
                                      formula = Total_W ~ as.factor(YearSeas.nm) +
                                        merged.bin,
                                      #time = NULL,

                                      # autocorrelation
                                      # Otherwise, use default "iid" 
                                      # (independent by time step)
                                      #spatiotemporal = "off",
                                      reml = FALSE) # Note for deviance explained
                                                    # you must use ML

sanity(m1_fixed_200plusSptlVarying)
# ✔ Non-linear minimizer suggests successful convergence
# ✔ Hessian matrix is positive definite
# ✔ No extreme or very small eigenvalues detected
# ✔ No gradients with respect to fixed effects are >= 0.001
# ✔ No fixed-effect standard errors are NA
# ✔ No standard errors look unreasonably large
# ✔ No sigma parameters are < 0.01
# ✔ No sigma parameters are > 100

```

Fixed + Spatial Random Effects

```{r, deviance.explained.by.fixed.plus.spatial.random.effects_200plusSptlVarying.w.sptl}

# 2. SPATIALLY VARYING COMPONENT ALONE 
# (This adds the 'spatial' engine to the fixed effects)
m2_sv_200plusSptlVarying <- update(m1_fixed_200plusSptlVarying, 
                        formula = Total_W ~ as.factor(YearSeas.nm) + merged.bin,
                        time = NULL,   
                        # Use "ar1" or "rw" if you expect temporal autocorrelation
                        # Otherwise, use default "iid" (independent by time step)

                        spatial = "on",
```

--- THE MATH ---

```{r, deviance.explained.by.component_200plusSptlVarying.w.sptl}

d0_200plusSptlVarying <- deviance(m0_200plusSptlVarying)
d1_200plusSptlVarying <- deviance(m1_fixed_200plusSptlVarying)
d2_200plusSptlVarying <- deviance(m2_sv_200plusSptlVarying)
d3_200plusSptlVarying <- deviance(m3_full_200plusSptlVarying)

# Percentages of total deviance explained by each:
pct_full_model_200plusSptlVarying <- 
  1 - d3_200plusSptlVarying / d0_200plusSptlVarying

pct_fixed_only_200plusSptlVarying <- 
  (d0_200plusSptlVarying - d1_200plusSptlVarying) / d0_200plusSptlVarying

pct_sv_only_200plusSptlVarying <- 
  (d1_200plusSptlVarying - d2_200plusSptlVarying) / d0_200plusSptlVarying

pct_st_only_200plusSptlVarying <- 
  (d2_200plusSptlVarying - d3_200plusSptlVarying) / d0_200plusSptlVarying

pct_full_model_200plusSptlVarying*100
```

## Remove fold two and and summarise the data

```{r, rmse.mae.model.comparisons.for.spatial.varying.partial.cv}

#-----------------------------------------------
#-----------------------------------------------
# For spatial varying effects with w/ sptl
#-----------------------------------------------
#-----------------------------------------------
#-----------------------------------------------
# 1. Station (Fold+Haul) Level Aggregation & Performance
# (RMSE / MAE)
#-----------------------------------------------

preds_200SptlVarying <- 
  cv_deltalognormalLogArea.sptlVarying.str4.200Models.reml$data %>%
   group_by(fold_id, keys) %>%
   summarize(
     # Total observed biomass at that station (sum of bins)
     obs_total = sum(Total_W), 
     # Total predicted biomass (sum of bin-level cv_predicted)
     pred_total = sum_or_na(cv_predicted),
     .groups = "drop"
   )

preds_200SptlVarying_comparison <- preds_200SptlVarying %>%
  group_by(fold_id) %>%
  summarize(
    rmse     = sqrt(mean((obs_total - pred_total)^2)),
    mae      = mean(abs(obs_total - pred_total)),
    sum_obs  = sum(obs_total),
    sum_pred = sum(pred_total),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(diff = sum_obs - sum_pred,
         Model = "2 LenBins 200 mm cut off (CoVar + sptl + Sptl Varying)")  %>%
  rename(.folds = fold_id)

#-----------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate Global Metrics
#-----------------------------------------------

final_200SptlVarying_summary <- preds_200SptlVarying %>%
  summarize(
    global_rmse = sqrt(mean((obs_total - pred_total)^2)),
    global_mae  = mean(abs(obs_total - pred_total)),
    .groups     = "drop" 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = 
      "2 LenBins 200 mm cut off (CoVar + sptl + Sptl Varying) - minus folds 2 & 5"
    )

```

## Join and save comparison of RMSE and MAE

```{r, join.save.rmse.mae}

test2.clip <- rbind(
  preds_200SptlVarying_comparison,
  preds_full.clip_comparison,
  preds_3bins.clip_comparison,
  preds_bin200.clip_comparison,
  preds_bin150.clip_comparison)

# Plotting the RMSE across folds
rmse.plot2.clip <-
  ggplot(test2.clip, aes(x = Model, y = rmse, color = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) + # Shows the spread across folds
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) +            # Shows the individual fold scores
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 17)) + # Wraps labels at ~15 chars
  labs(#title = "Model Predictive Performance across Passed CV Folds",
       y = "RMSE (Lower is Better)", 
       x = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), # Horizontal & tight line spacing) 
        legend.position = "none") # Optional: hides legend if color already matches x-axis labels)

rmse.plot2.clip

ggsave2(filename = "SpatialVaryinglengthBinSelectionViaRMSE.jpeg",
        plot = rmse.plot2.clip, 
        device ="jpeg",
        path = here(dir, "Final.Figures"),
        dpi = 1200, width = 29, height = 21,
        unit = "cm", limitsize = FALSE)

fwrite(test,
       here(dir, "Final.Results",
            "CV_Fold_StatisticsTableForSpatialVaryingLengthBinSelection.csv"),
       sep = ",")

#---------------------------------
# For summary table
#---------------------------------

test3.clip <- rbind(final_200SptlVarying_summary,
                    final_full.clip_summary,
                    final_3bins.clip_summary,
                    final_bin200.clip_summary, 
                    final_bin150.clip_summary
                    )

test3.clip <- test3.clip %>%
  select(
    Model,
    `Global CV RMSE` = global_rmse,
    `Global CV MAE`  = global_mae
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ref_rmse = final_full.clip_summary$global_rmse,
    ref_mae = final_full.clip_summary$global_mae
  ) %>%
  # Calculate % difference relative to final_full_summary
  mutate(
    `% Δ RMSE` = (`Global CV RMSE` - ref_rmse) / ref_rmse * 100,
    `% Δ MAE`  = (`Global CV MAE`  - ref_mae)  / ref_mae  * 100
  ) %>%
  # Optional: sort best to worst by RMSE
  arrange(`Global CV RMSE`) %>%
  select(-c(ref_rmse, ref_mae))

View(test3.clip)

fwrite(test3.clip, 
       here(dir, "Final.Results",
            "Global_CV_SummaryTableForSpatialVaryingLengthBinSelection.csv"),
       sep = ",")
```
